name: download
description: Represents a file or data download action. The arrow translates downward toward the baseline surface on hover.

animation.description: Hold-to-loop receiving: while hovered, arrows fall into the tray one after another (fall 0.28s, tray flex 0.2s, settle-through 0.16s per cycle). Looping is justified because a download affordance is a transfer/progress indicator. Press, focus, or manual trigger plays a single cycle. Leave stops the loop and resets to rest. Reduced motion: static.

accessibility.notes: Provide context when used inside a button or link.
